text: At the beginning of the song, your child’s fist should be closed, apart from their thumb.
imageUrl: One little bunny 2, one more by counting-IAWeU12qTxb4b4f3VteCM.png

text:
As you sing the song together, help your child to count the bunnies on their fingers.

One little bunny wondering what to do

One little bunny wondering what to do,

Another bunny came along and then there were two. (put the second finger up)

Two little bunnies hopping like me,

Another one came along and then there were three. (put the third finger up)

Three little bunnies jumping around outdoors,

Another bunny joined them, and then there were four. (put the fourth finger up)

Four little bunnies so fluffy and alive,

Another bunny joined them, and then there were five. (put the little finger up)

Five little bunnies ready for some fun,

Hopped away in the warm spring sun.



Repeat the song to learn it together!
You’re going to be counting bunnies. To begin, help your child to draw bunnies on the fingertips of one of their hands.
